bibl.title: Śivatattvarahasya
bibl.persName: Appayya Dīkṣitapredecessor; his works on the same theme are quoted (Śivārkamaṇidīpikā, Brahmatarkastava, and Śivatattvaviveka)
bibl.note: Unni, N. P. Nilakantha Diksita. Sahitya Akademi, 1995.
It is a commentary on the Śaṅkarasaṃhitā (108 names of Śiva) of the Skandapurāṇa.
It also refers to Śaṅkara and his work the Saundaryalaharī.
The following grammarians are all cited: Pāṇini, Patañjali, Kaiyaṭa, Haradatta, Kāśikākāra, and Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita.
